item: Row J: the law catalogue is parsed with libyaml, so a steady seeder boot is 1.8-1.9 s instead of 2.6-2.8 s
refs: R153; branch claude/v0-5-plan-j8zvre (PR number at push)
summary: load_legal_catalog used yaml.safe_load (pure Python): 0.43 s for the 297 KB generated catalogue, parsed twice per boot, while sources.yml already used libyaml. It now reads through seed_sources._load_safe_yaml (libyaml where available, the pure safe loader otherwise); the parsed objects are identical to the pure parser's on sources.yml and both legal catalogues by a type-aware, alias-aware digest, pinned in tests/test_law_catalog_loader.py. Measured on the real catalogues: steady boot 2.6-2.8 s to 1.8-1.9 s, first install 10.6 s to 9.9 s. A per-boot memo saved only 0.05-0.1 s on top and was not added; a first-install prefresh (10.6 s to 6.9 s) is recorded as an OPEN_QUEUE note, not built.
